response.original_title: 【Cruise FAQ Guide】 How do I add a new room on a Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: To add another room to an existing Carnival Cruise reservation, +1-866-758-2031 you must book a separate new stateroom and call Carnival Cruises customer service at +1-866-758-2031(US) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin:+1-866-758-2031  You cannot add a room to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new stateroom online or via phone. Contact Carnival Cruises at +1-866-758-2031(US) or your travel agent. You cannot directly add a new +1-866-758-2031 physical stateroom to an existing reservation online; instead, you must book a separate room and have it linked by calling Carnival Cruise customer service at +1-866-758-2031
